text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race itself begins. On top of the bad 
track conditions caused by torrential 
rain, Kitasan Black is among the 
competitors. It's going to be a brutal 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To defeat her, taking risks would be 
necessary. That very adversity fires 
Satono Crown up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of the mud, a decisive battle 
putting each other's pride on the line 
begins now...!
